clips.title: The story
paras: Smith Argus sends you from Goldshire to Stormwind to help Grimand Elmore. The dwarven weaponsmith needs help with a delivery bound for his kin in Khaz Modan, and Argus trusts you to make the journey.

In Goldshire, blacksmith Smith Argus watches for travelers he can trust with work beyond clearing wolves and kobolds. Grimand Elmore, a skilled dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, has asked for help with a delivery to his kin in Khaz Modan. Argus sees you as fit for the journey and sends you toward the city gates to answer Elmore's call.

Stormwind and Ironforge depend on open trade and goodwill to keep both realms supplied and united. Argus says Elwynn Forest needs defenders, but honoring promises to the dwarves matters too. In northeastern Stormwind, the Dwarven District leads you to Elmore's shop, where a journey beyond the forest begins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery. I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.
You have a sturdy pair on you! So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand. We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.
You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're here to help with my delivery? Very good!
